meta_title: Perton Plumbing & Heating | Gas Engineer Wolverhampton
meta_description: Perton Plumbing and Heating — Gas Safe registered heating engineer in Wolverhampton. Boiler repairs, installations, servicing. Fast response, fair prices.
hero_subhead: Boiler broken down? We're out to you fast. Repairs, installations, and servicing across Wolverhampton and Perton.
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full system installations, we handle all your gas heating and plumbing needs.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Boiler stopped mid-winter? We diagnose and repair most faults the same day, with parts carried on the van. No call-out charge.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted and commissioned. We advise on efficiency ratings, handle all the paperwork, and guarantee the work for 12 months.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating running safely and efficiently. We clean, inspect, and test — spotting problems before they become emergencies.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full system design and installation. We survey your home, specify the right radiators and pipework, and test everything before handover.

services.title: Radiator Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Leaking or cold radiators? We repair seals, bleed air, or fit new rads. Works with any boiler system.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Annual safety inspection and certification for rental properties or insurance compliance. All work documented and registered.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, fix it right, and charge you fair prices.
about_para_1: Perton Plumbing and Heating was started because we saw too many homeowners overcharged by distant call centres and cowboys. With over 15 years' experience as a Gas Safe registered engineer, we've built a reputation for honest work, quick response times, and prices that don't shock you when the invoice arrives.
about_para_2: We're based in Perton, we know Wolverhampton, and we treat every job — whether a £150 radiator bleed or a £5,000 boiler install — with the same care. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals. That's not an accident.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on Boxing Day. I rang Perton expecting a massive bill, but they got someone round within the hour and had it firing again by suppertime. Fair price too — no silly call-out charges. Will 100% use them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a full new central heating system installed. Mick was really clear about what we were getting, showed us options, and the lads did a tidy job. They cleaned up after themselves and left good instructions. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Annual service and safety cert done. They spotted a small issue with the valve, explained what it meant, and fixed it as part of the service call. No pressure, just honest advice. That's why we keep using them.
reviews.author: David P.
